subject: Trust portal invite rotation and local time confirmation
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@goldcrest-audit.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 access window + timezone for walkthrough

Hi Tessa / Marissa,

Hope you're both well. Greylake's external audit team (Goldcrest) is scheduling a short live walkthrough next week and we need temporary access to Redwood's trust portal to pull the SOC 2 Type II report and a supporting bridge letter. A few practical items so we can align: 

- Preferred window: Tue/Wed next week (Greylake auditors are in ET). Can you confirm you can issue a time-limited invite that covers 90 minutes?
- Download rights: we need read + download for the SOC 2 PDF, and view-only for system diagrams.
- Auth model: we can accept an SSO SAML plug or a one-time ephemeral link with MFA.
- Timezone note: auditors are asking if the link expiry will use UTC or Redwood local timezone — how are expiry timestamps represented in the portal?

I've attached a short request form for any required fields (SOC2_TypeII_request_form.xlsx). If you can send an example link TTL and whether IP allowlisting will be required, that would help our scheduling.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Senior Manager, Goldcrest Audit Services
liam.oconnor@goldcrest-audit.com

Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_request_form.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@goldcrest-audit.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 access window + timezone for walkthrough

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear asks and the form.

Short answers up front: we can provide a one-time ephemeral portal link with download rights for the SOC 2 PDF, and the link expiry is expressed in UTC in the portal UI and in the invite metadata. We can also enable MFA for the session.

Operational details we need from you:
- Exact list of auditor emails for the invite (please populate the attached form).
- Confirm whether you need privileged SSO (SAML) or if the one-time link is acceptable. If SSO, please share the IdP metadata; SSO provisioning takes longer.
- Any IP ranges to allow if you plan to use a fixed location (optional).

Proposed plan: we can issue an ephemeral link that:
- Expires 48 hours from issuance (we can extend to 72h upon request),
- Allows PDF download for files tagged as "auditor:download",
- Logs auditor email and IP in our audit trail (we'll provide a CSV of access events afterwards).

If Tue/Wed ET works for you, suggest we issue the link one hour before the walkthrough so there is time for MFA and onboarding. I'll coordinate with Marissa on the link issuance and include a bridge-letter template if you need it.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Manager, Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0123

Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 13:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 access window + timezone for walkthrough

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the quick response. For the live walkthrough we expect two auditors: liam.oconnor@goldcrest-audit.com and shelly.yu@goldcrest-audit.com. One has a dynamic IP (traveling), the other will be on an office network.

We are fine with a one-time ephemeral link + MFA; SSO isn't necessary for this session. Can you confirm the TTL is expressed in UTC (you mentioned yes) and whether the TTL start is the moment the link is issued or when the first click occurs?

Tentative time: Wed 7/7, 13:00 - 14:30 ET (that is 17:00 - 18:30 UTC). If you can provision the link at 16:00 UTC (one hour before) and set expiry to 72 hours from issuance that would be perfect.

Last ask: can you also include a brief bridge letter confirming the audit period (2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31) to accompany the download?

Best regards,
Auditor Scheduling
Goldcrest Audit Services

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@goldcrest-audit.com>, Auditor Scheduling <scheduling@goldcrest-audit.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 07:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 access window + timezone for walkthrough

Hi Liam / scheduling —

We can proceed as requested. A few confirmations and the access artefacts below: 

- TTL behavior: expiry countdown starts at moment of issuance (UTC). The portal UI shows both UTC and the recipient's browser locale.
- Issuance plan: link will be generated at 16:00 UTC on 2027-07-07 and sent to the two auditor emails. Link will be valid for 72 hours (expires 2027-07-10T16:00:00Z).
- Downloads: SOC 2 Type II PDF will be in the "auditor:download" bucket. We will enable download and log events.
- Bridge letter: attached is a template we will populate with audit-period language and sign off internally.

Access artefact (placeholder): https://trust.redwood.ai/s/8f3d1a2b
This link will be replaced with a time-limited token at issuance.

Attachment: bridge-letter-template.docx (docx)

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks Marissa and Tessa. 

We'll confirm the two auditor emails in the populated form and plan to join the 13:00 ET slot on Wed 7/7. The bridge letter language looks good; we'll flag any minor edits early tomorrow. Appreciate the clear TTL rules (UTC start on issuance) — that resolves our scheduling question.

See you Wed.

Best,
Liam
